q: An idea of what the room should put on the canvas, offered to the room
w: Calls for help with sprites members have started lead (T3-002). Edited comments send the sub's video audience to the r/place project (T3-002); the usual ASPE and MegaMari entries that carry them are the sub's ordinary posting (T3-017), concepts of their own, as reader A and my B1 have it.
